The credential-split test asserts `'ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN' in work` by serialising the parsed job back to YAML with `yaml.safe_dump`. This will match if the string appears anywhere in the job's YAML — including in a comment. Comments are stripped by `yaml.safe_load`, so `id_tokens:` is the only mechanism that would survive the round-trip. The `git remote set-url` assertion checks that the work job cannot push by scanning `yaml.safe_dump(parsed['work'])`. `git remote set-url` does not appear in the work job's script in the scaffold, so this assertion will pass. But it is a negative assertion on serialised YAML: if the command were placed in an artifact path name or a variable value, `safe_dump` would still include it and the assertion would fire correctly.
